services.name: Banana Boat Ride
services.desc: We operate right off the beach right behind Pompano Joe's in Miramar Beach! Our captain is the highest rated in Destin and holds a USCG license. He will tailor the ride to suit your preference. The rides average about 12-14 minutes holding a maximum of 6 passengers at a time. Banana Boat Captain will not operate faster than 20 mph due to safety regulations. Riders must follow safety rules or ride will be terminated for your safety, without refund. Please do not bring personal items such as cell phones or anything you do not want to lose. gap: PARASAILING POLICIES WEATHER: The availability of parasail flights depends entirely on the weather. Weather is the biggest variable with parasailing, to be specific wind is the biggest factor. It’s the ‘Parasail Captain’s Call’ on determining if weather conditions will permit the activity.
blurb: We have the best maintained, most advanced, USCG Inspected Multi-Passenger Vessels on the beach. We have multiple boats accommodating up to 12 passengers per boat.
extraNote: PARASAILING POLICIES WEATHER: The availability of parasail flights depends entirely on the weather. · Weather is the biggest variable with parasailing, to be specific wind is the biggest factor. · It’s the ‘Parasail Captain’s Call’ on determining if weather conditions will permit the activity. · If cancellation occurs outside of these parameters, you will not be eligible for a refund. · If weather is deemed unfavorable by the captain, the session may be rescheduled for a later time/date, or a full refund will be issued. · Riders must follow safety rules or ride will be terminated for your safety, without refund. · Walton Beach Parasail, LLC.

checkin: What to Bring? Please arrive at least 30-45 minutes prior to scheduled appointment. (parking and traffic can be challenging) We don't recommend cameras or electronics due to the saltwater environment. Wear normal beach clothing you don't mind getting wet. Sunglasses are usually ok, but a strap is a good idea. We are located behind Pompano Joe's Restaurant!
